newsitem.title: USA: DLJ opens London investment services unit.
newsitem.headline: DLJ opens London investment services unit.

text.p: Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Inc said Monday its London-based affiliate, DLJ International Ltd, opened an office of its Investment Services Group in London.
Thomas Dicker, 43, has been hired as a managing director responsible for expanding the group's European client base and developing an appropriate product range, the firm said.
Dicker reports to Michael J. Campbell, head of DLJ's Investment Services Group, based in New York City.

"This is DLJ's first Investment Services Group office outside of the United States and as part of the firm's strategy to expand internationally provides an excellent complement to the existing areas of business in DLJ's London office," said Campbell.
